meta.name: BASE44_BUILD_PLAN
meta.purpose: THE consolidated plan: everything pending from the original idea (2026-07-08 dictation) plus every add-on decided along the way, in one ordered queue. BASE44_APP_SPEC.json stays the static design index; PROGRESS.md stays the append-only ledger and wins on what-happened conflicts. v2 supersedes v1: Slice 6.5 is now IN FLIGHT (4 approved passes), Slice 7 is BUILT pending the Meshy provider swap, and the original-idea leftovers are queued explicitly.
meta.how_to_use: Owner says 'continue the plan'. Agent: (1) read this file + PROTOCOL.md; (2) take the lowest-order work_queue item with actor 'base44' whose blocking list is clear; (3) run it per PROTOCOL steps 2-7 (load slice + specialists, 3-line confirm, build, gate-stop, acceptance PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED, ledger append); (4) never start an item whose blocking entry is open; (5) actor 'owner'/'codex' items are not yours - skip silently; (6) one queue item = one build message; stop after 2 failed fix attempts.
meta.honesty_contract: Tags [FACT]/[FACT-source]/[ESTIMATE]/[METHOD]/[UNKNOWN]/[SIGNAL] are load-bearing. evidence_grade distinguishes owner-reported from audit-verified; never upgrade without the audit.
meta.credit_discipline: PROTOCOL.md credit section binds. Manual visual edits are free - cosmetic follow-ups go through the visual editor, not prompts.
